description: Who owns which Playwright spec, and which product flows those specs prove. Validated by scripts/ci/check-coverage-manifest.mjs (npm run check:coverage); human-readable gap list in docs/ci/COVERAGE.md.

runners.patient: Patient booking, intake, checkout, discounts, pay later, isolation and the patient's phone view
runners.therapist: Therapist roster, readiness, specialty and the therapist's phone view
runners.session: Session lifecycle: scheduling, suggestions, completion, clinical continuity, care-plan review
runners.admin: The back office: authorization, exposure, money screens, validation, navigation, lifecycle
runners.platform: The public site and shared UI: navigation, splash, catalog, form controls, mobile smoke
runners.integrity: Storage-layer and destructive checks: SQL check files, authorization and concurrency scripts, live grants, refund ledger, degraded schema

allowedSkips.reason: Skips itself while the pre-launch debug bar is on -- the bar lists the admin routes by design and is on in every environment until release (src/lib/debugNavVisible.ts). debug-clock and the admin specs need the bar, so the gate keeps it on; AE-001 still proves a non-admin is never sent to the back office. Remove this entry when the bar is switched off.

flows.title: Self-signup returns a session with no email step, lands unapproved, and waits on the admin
Per-specialty intake, Pain Map, re-triage, and clinical access following live or delivered care
Lead time, bulk-schedule limit, cancellation window and the unserviceable-pincode refusal

tests: a slot inside the configured lead-time window is rejected
a batch larger than the admin-configured max

flows.title: Only a patient account can book; every other role is told why and offered its way home

The booking wizard: service picker, deep links, named specialist, exit link, a pay button that stays tappable, a cancelled payment retried at the same slot, and a new account locked until it pays or runs out of tries
Consultation first: direct programme purchase is gone and a stale link is answered
Checkout answers with the quote and the Razorpay order in one trip, and records timing without identity
flows.limitation: Needs Razorpay test keys (RAZORPAY_TEST_KEY_ID/SECRET): CS-001 creates a real test-mode order.

flows.title: Promo codes quote with no amount in the request, caps hold, paused codes do nothing, invites cannot be self-claimed
A 100%-off booking resolves to zero, confirms with no payment row, and refuses anything still owed
Pay later end to end: grant, a booking with no payment screen, completion, declaration, settlement, write-off
A paid purchase nobody booked against is counted and opens exactly the rows it counted
The home-visit master switch and the serve-area waitlist
A patient pays through Razorpay Checkout and the capture is verified (signature, webhook, idempotent re-delivery)
flows.limitation: No spec drives the hosted Checkout sheet or posts a signed verify/webhook payload. Needs Razorpay test-mode checkout automation or a signed-webhook fixture built from a generated RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET; neither exists yet.

flows.title: A patient cancels and the automatic refund (outside the window) or no refund (inside it) reaches the gateway
flows.limitation: The cancellation window copy and setting are covered (booking-rules); a cancellation that triggers a gateway refund is not exercised because it needs a captured test-mode payment.

flows.title: A patient uploads a report through the route; it is typed by its bytes, stored in a private bucket and opened through a short-lived signed link
Roster: ranges, exceptions, leave, authorization, stale and double-clicked saves, first save, day view
A therapist's readiness checklist and specialisation as a value
A therapist's own earnings and payout history match the admin's figures
flows.limitation: Payout arithmetic is covered from the admin side (admin.money-maths) and in payout-atomicity-sql-checks.sql; the therapist's own earnings screen has no spec.

flows.title: Booking the sessions a patient paid for: five in one request, programme rules, lead time, expiry, ownership
Therapist-suggested sessions: suggesting spends nothing, accepting books once, races settle on one answer
The Session Completed cutoff on every surface that lists a session
The debug clock moves the completion gate only while the debug bar is on
flows.limitation: Asserts refusals only: a successful completion writes append-only settlement rows (those are exercised by clinical-continuity on the disposable stack).

flows.title: A therapist's recommendation is queued and invisible, refused at checkout, then approved, declined or approved with changes
A confirmed session gets a Google Calendar event and Meet link
flows.limitation: GOOGLE_CALENDAR_* must be unset in CI, so the app runs in its 'not configured' mode and no event is created. Real Meet creation needs a provider-sandbox check done by hand.

flows.title: Reminders, confirmations and other outbound messages
flows.limitation: The codebase has no email, SMS or WhatsApp provider; GoTrue mail goes to the local Mailpit only. Nothing to test until a provider exists.

flows.title: Every admin route refuses anonymous and non-admin callers; a limited scope cannot cross sections; scoped landing screens
The back office is not named to anyone outside it
flows.limitation: AE-002 skips itself while the debug bar is on (it lists admin routes by design).

flows.title: Payout and refund arithmetic: travel fee, cash netting, unconfigured share, refund window setting, activity-log attribution
Admin routes answer malformed bodies with a 400, never leak a stack, and bound every setting
Dashboard sections, deep links, overlays, failure handling and the refresh badge
Two admins at once: realtime coverage, inbox removal, racing approve/decline, double assignment
Account creation stamps, deletion only with no history, partner layouts and credential reset
Settings information architecture, the booking lead time reaching the patient picker, package form switches
A person's sessions ordered by session date, and the log's subject timeline
The Risk screen names the rules an incomplete sweep missed and the report is admin-only
The real admin login form: valid, wrong password, a patient's credentials

tests: valid admin credentials reach the dashboard
a patient's credentials cannot open the admin dashboard

flows.limitation: Runs only when the app answers at E2E_LOGIN_BASE_URL; the admin runner points it at the same dev server because the CI browser reaches the local stack directly. If that variable is dropped the spec skips itself.

flows.title: An admin refund reaches Razorpay and the result is recorded against the right session
flows.limitation: Refund arithmetic and the attempt record are covered (admin.money-maths, integrity.refund-attempt-ledger); a refund that actually calls the gateway needs a captured test-mode payment.

flows.title: The scheduled maintenance sweeps (risk, retention, balance verification) run on a cron
flows.limitation: maintenance.yml calls the sweeps on a schedule against the hosted project; no spec drives the sweep routes with CRON_SECRET.

flows.title: One open referral per patient under five simultaneous submissions; a withdrawn one frees the number; a dropped connection is said
A referred patient's paid session accrues the hospital's revenue share and the figure matches the admin's
flows.limitation: Needs a captured payment on a referred patient; the share arithmetic is in admin-money and the SQL checks but not driven through a referral end to end.

flows.title: The public pages' section rail, scroll arrow, and a tap acknowledged on real navigation
The brand splash's cold-open, reload and long-absence rules and its admin settings
The public catalog's dialogs and covers render the same on card, dialog and booking screen
The home walkthrough's admin-configured rotation pace
The clinic's own date field, numeric box and validation messages in place of the browser's
The footer's developer credit end to end and the footer's social links
Public pages and every role's dashboard fit a phone
The refund attempt is written before the gateway is called and cannot be rewritten from the service-role client
CAS-guarded races at the routes: one refund reaches the gateway, one reassignment wins, one referral books the slot
flows.limitation: The refund race calls Razorpay with a fake payment id, so it needs Razorpay test keys.

flows.title: With ALLOW_DEBUG_DATA_RESET unset the reset is refused to everyone and cannot leave no admin

tests: a full admin without the confirmation phrase is refused
the reset function refuses to leave no admin behind

flows.title: A missing migration-dependent column or table empties its own panel and nothing else
Append-only triggers, the ledger, settlements, payouts, rate limits, promo caps, roster payloads and slot claims at the storage layer
Cross-tenant isolation, IDOR, enumeration and suspension asserted below the routes with real user tokens
Parallel RPCs at claim_therapist_slot, the rate limiter and the invite cap return exactly one winner
flows.limitation: Guards the verdicts, not serialisation (see the caveat at the top of the script).

flows.title: The live database's function grants and RLS agree with schema.sql (three outcomes: pass, fail, not proven)
The armed reset truncates only what it should and keeps the admin
flows.limitation: ALLOW_DEBUG_DATA_RESET must stay unset everywhere, including CI, and debug-reset-sql-checks.sql takes AccessExclusiveLock on every table. It is deliberately not run by the gate.

flows.title: Another patient can neither open nor delete a patient's report, and their own RLS client reads none of the patient's clinical or money rows or export

Health profile, session note and recommendation carried across therapist, admin and patient: access limited to the treating therapist, notes never patient-visible, a queued plan invisible and unbuyable until approved, approval attributed, and a reopen losing nothing
A second partner hospital cannot read, enumerate, withdraw or see on its screen another partner's referral; the owning hospital can
Saved addresses: save, remove, and another patient refused
flows.limitation: No spec drives /api/patient/addresses/save or /remove yet. Feasible on the local stack; not yet written.

flows.title: A patient rates a completed session and leaves feedback
flows.limitation: No spec drives the rating/feedback write; admin-money only reads rating exclusions. Feasible; not yet written.

flows.title: The Meet link is shown only inside the join window
flows.limitation: Meet links need GOOGLE_CALENDAR_* (forbidden in CI); the join-window rule has unit tests in src/lib but no browser journey.

flows.title: A patient buys a programme through Razorpay and receives session credits
flows.limitation: Needs the Razorpay test checkout sheet driven in a browser or a signed verify payload; consultation-first only proves the refusal path. Needs a provider-sandbox decision.

flows.title: Assignment, reassignment and no-show handling through the admin and therapist routes
flows.limitation: claim_therapist_slot is proven at the RPC (therapist-slot-sql-checks.sql, concurrency-checks.mjs) but no spec drives the assignment or no-show routes.

flows.title: A therapist records cash collected at the door and requests a payout
flows.limitation: No spec drives /api/therapist/record-cash-collection or /request-payout; payout atomicity is proven in SQL only. Feasible; not yet written.

flows.title: Going on leave blocks new bookings without moving existing ones
flows.limitation: therapist-roster covers leave on the roster screen; /api/therapist/set-on-leave itself has no spec.

flows.title: Support impersonation: who may start it, what it may do, and the audit row it leaves
flows.limitation: No spec drives /api/admin/start-impersonation or /stop-impersonation. Needs the impersonation rules in docs/rules/ops-security.md turned into cases; not yet written.

flows.title: A captured payment whose verify call was lost is recovered by the webhook, exactly once
flows.limitation: Needs signed Razorpay webhook payloads (RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET) posted to the local app; the idempotency is proven in booking-idempotency-sql-checks.sql only. Needs an owner decision on a webhook test secret.
